purpose: Contract governance, SDK distribution and cross-repository compatibility. Not a runtime gateway.

services.auth: Appwrite session JWT; Backend validates and derives identity
services.notes: Backend is the only public product API runtime and canonical authority for local and remote social relationships, public posts and privacy. It transactionally enqueues opted-in public posts for Federation and rechecks public eligibility on object dereference.

services.auth: Obtains Appwrite JWT and sends it only to Backend public API
services.notes: Must never call private services, PostgreSQL, storage credentials, Federation or Algorithm directly.

services.auth: PLATFORM_INTERNAL_TOKEN for protected writes; public config read is restricted to enabled public keys
services.notes: The Backend main branch does not yet have a verified typed platform client. The platform API is not a product API. Video and notification services are separately catalogued and need their own audited contracts before client generation. Source audit found OpenAPI/handler drift: config/set returns 200 JSON while spec says 204; generic route handlers do not enforce documented methods; some schema constraints are not fully enforced. See conformance report.

services.auth: Public objects by policy; private media requires expiring key-bound playback authorization; purge uses PURGE_TOKEN
services.notes: CDN never decides product ownership or post visibility. Hostname, origin, TLS and private-media end-to-end behavior remain deployment gates. Source audit found that asset authorization currently allows requests when PLAYBACK_SECRET is empty; fail-closed behavior and private playback tests are required before production use.

authority: signed delivery of Backend-authorized public Create activities
public dereferencing of Backend-canonical ActivityPub Notes
services.auth: Public ActivityPub ingress uses HTTP Signatures; Backend-to-Federation uses a distinct service bearer; Federation-to-Backend uses a different service bearer
services.notes: Backend remains authoritative for local identity, privacy, blocks, visibility, remote-follow relationships and canonical public post objects. Federation owns ActivityPub execution, signed inbox receipts, actor keys and delivery state. Public routing and workers remain gated; durable inbox acceptance is not proof of completed delivery. Follow/Undo are projected into Backend's canonical remote_follows table; unimplemented inbound Create/Update/Delete/Like/Announce/Accept/Reject/Block activities are rejected with 422 until Backend projections exist. Public Note dereferencing is proxied through Backend's eligibility-checked private object endpoint. Directional service credentials are independent.

authority: ranking order and ranking scores only
services.notes: Backend submits at most 200 already-authorized candidates and requests at most 50. Ranker may return only submitted IDs; Backend rechecks visibility and hydrates canonical records.
